people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
translations.bsb: “I will ask you one question,” Jesus replied, “and if you answer Me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
translations.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
translations.asv: And Jesus said unto them, I will ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
